title: Marka Žvaka - Najbolje pekare u Beogradu | Best bakeries in Belgrade
description:
Koja beogradska pekara ima najbolji burek? Gde su najbolje kifle i pogačice? Stavovi koji su izneti u videu ne predstavljaju zvaničan stav Unije pekara niti Udruženja stomatologa! Pekara Crvena Zvezda (gazda Maksim) sa naj burekom se nalazi u Karđorđevoj 61a, preko puta hotela Bristol i Geozavoda. Pekara Čarli je u ulici Braće Jugovića 16, pored nekadašnjeg bioskopa Balkan.

Which Belgrade bakery has the best “burek”? And which one has the best bread rolls and scones? The opinions presented in this video don’t apply to the opinions of The Bakers Association nor the Dental Association! “Crvena zvezda” bakery (the boss Maksim) that sells the best “burek” is situated on 61a Karađorđeva Street, across from Hotel Bristol and Geozavod. “Čarli” bakery is situated on 16 Braće Jugovića Street, next to the former movie theater Balkan.
